facts.text: Retinal 0.1% Face Serum
Mid-Strength Retinal to visibly reduce signs of aging

A lightweight anti-aging serum formulated with Retinal, Oleyl Adapalenate, Bakuchiol, and Squalane to combat the visible signs of aging. Retinal, one of the most efficacious form of Vitamin-A, helps fight fine line, wrinkles, and uneven skin tone while improving elasticity and texture. By encouraging cell turnover, this serum promotes a more youthful, radiant complexion.

Retinal (0.1%): A powerful yet gentle form of Vitamin A, It is known for its superior efficacy in reducing fine lines, wrinkles, and uneven skin tone. It promotes cell turnover, revealing a more youthful, radiant complexion. As per a clinical study it improves photoaging by 95%.

Oleyl Adapalenate: Adapinoid is the only third generation retinoid for cosmetic use. This novel active is a precursor of adapalene which is proven to increase collagen, reduce photoaging, balance skin tone, soothe inflammation, reduce pores, and clear acne-prone skin.
Bakuchiol: Bakuchiol reduces inflammation by significantly decreasing PGE2 level, IL-6 and MIF protein level.

Squalane: A very lightweight moisturising agent that naturally seals moisture and significantly reduces trans-epidermal water loss in cases wherein the skin barrier is disrupted. Non-sticky and non-comedogenic.
Skin type: All skin types
Concerns: Fine lines, Wrinkles, Inflammation
Suitable for: 18+ years of age
Oleyl Adapalenate at 0.5% concentration has shown significant results:
2.3 times more potent than retinol in reduction of wrinkle severity
9.6 times more effective to reduce redness
74.7 times more effective to reduce TEWL,
Not only shows result but also it is better tolerable than 0.5% retinol.
Apply on cleansed face after your water-based serums, and before moisturiser. Use of sunscreen is highly recommended the next day of using this product.
Use in PM routine only. Start with every alternate day and after 2 weeks of
usage, use it everyday.

facts.section: When should I start using Retinal Serum?
facts.text: Ideally, begin using Retinal in your late 20s to prevent early signs of aging. If you already have fine lines or wrinkles, it can still be beneficial for corrective care.
